input:
* I want to add the ability to create snippets while working through a protocol in the Runner, as well as directly through a command-line command. The Runner modal should include an icon that, when clicked after selecting some text, opens a modal similar to the one used when creating a snippet through the Snippet Editor. The selected text should already be inserted into the modal, so that I can add placeholders where needed, edit the text, and save the newly created snippet to the desired directory.

* When I run the **“Insert snippet”** command, a modal appears that allows me to select a snippet using either navigation or search. However, I do not like the way this modal “jumps” while I am searching for a snippet, as though it is constantly trying to recenter itself. I would prefer the modal to remain fixed near the top of the screen, with the list of matching results expanding downward or shrinking as the search query changes. This would be easier on the eyes, and the visual focus would remain on the modal.

  I would also like to be able to select a snippet using the arrow keys and insert it by pressing **Enter**, in addition to selecting it with the mouse.

  Currently, each snippet in this modal displays both its name and the path where it is stored. For convenience, I would prefer to display only the snippet name.

findings.detail: Slice 4 bundles two independent capabilities via '+' in its title and scope: (1) keyboard navigation c4 (ArrowUp/ArrowDown highlight + Enter dispatch, highlightedIndex/highlightedRowEl field, .rp-stp-row-highlighted class, keydown listener on search input, broadening removeListenersExceptSearch to preserve 'keydown', i18n aria-label keys) and (2) name-only display c5 (hideSearchResultPath option on SnippetTreePickerOptions, gating the path div in renderFileRow/renderFolderRow, passing hideSearchResultPath:true from InsertSnippetModal.onOpen). These are two distinct architecture decisions on the same file with disjoint mechanics and independent user outcomes (interaction rule vs display rule), so a single design-slice pass would have to resolve two decisions at once. design-slice does no discovery and reads only the slice's Draws-on, so a bundled slice silently starves one of the two decisions. Re-cut: split Slice 4 along the feature seam into 4a (keyboard navigation only) and 4b (name-only display only). 4a keeps Draws-on snippet-tree-picker.ts mount()/:130 addListener, :168 removeListenersExceptSearch, :377-380 renderFileRow, inline-runner-modal.ts:672-695, i18n locales. 4b keeps Draws-on snippet-tree-picker.ts:62-72 SnippetTreePickerOptions, :377-380 path-div gate (shared cite is fine), insert-snippet-modal.ts:21-43 onOpen. Both remain standalone verticals with no deps and clean fences; Slice 4 currently owns one shared contract (hideSearchResultPath) which stays with 4b, so the <=1 contract rule holds for each re-cut slice.

data.feedback: Split Slice 4 into two slices along the keyboard-nav vs name-only-display seam: 4a = SnippetTreePicker keyboard navigation (c4), 4b = SnippetTreePicker name-only display via hideSearchResultPath (c5). Each is one coherent architecture decision with a bounded cited footing, standalone vertical, no deps, and <=1 shared contract (hideSearchResultPath stays with 4b). Slices 1-3 pass as written.

Adds i18n keys in two namespaces (`snippetEditor.createdNotice` for the command's post-save Notice; `protocolRunner.createSnippetFromSelection` for the runner button's aria-label) and one CSS rule for the disabled runner icon button.

risks.claim: SnippetEditorModal opened from InlineRunnerModal (a custom DOM overlay, not an Obsidian Modal) stacks above the runner overlay by Obsidian's default modal z-index — the research names modal-stacking-from-custom-backdrop as the codebase's #1 recurring failure pattern and requires validation-time verification.

The pin rule assumes Obsidian centers .modal via flex align-items: center on .modal-container; if a future Obsidian version switches .modal to absolute/fixed positioning, align-self: flex-start no longer opts out and the pin would need top:0; bottom:auto instead.

Slice 4 (Phase 4) and Slice 5 (Phase 5) both edit src/views/snippet-tree-picker.ts; the sub-plans assert disjoint edit regions (Phase 4: mount() listener, removeListenersExceptSearch(), re-render bodies; Phase 5: SnippetTreePickerOptions interface + renderFileRow path-div gate). Validate that the two phases' line ranges do not collide and that the broadened removeListenersExceptSearch() keep-predicate does not regress Phase 5's path-display gate or vice-versa.

Query-on-keypress navigation (Phase 4 currentRows()) assumes every visible list row carries .rp-stp-folder-row or .rp-stp-file-row and lives under the current .rp-stp-list. Phase 5's name-only display changes only the path-div inside renderFileRow, not the row's own class, so the contract should hold — but verify the row-class + .rp-stp-list container contract is preserved across every render path both phases touch.

Plan faithfully mirrors the codebase's dominant conventions; no pattern divergences found.
